title.ja: 全裸王[ユウシャ]世界に起つ!
title.en: A Full-Frontal Hero Arises in the World!

1.overview: "Peace and quiet is the best!" That's the motto of everyday high schooler, Tomoki Sakurai. But his peaceful life is being torn apart after the girl Ikaros suddenly fell from the sky one day. She calls herself a "Pet-class Angeloid", and Tomoki her "Master" because he's the first person on Earth she met. Also, she has the mysterious power to make all his wishes come true!
1.summary:
Tomoki’s life gets turned upside down when beautiful, winged Ikaros falls from the sky and starts calling him master! She offers to make his every wish come true – and his first wish  is for world domination!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 天翔ける虹色下着[ロマン]

2.overview: Sohara is in a bad mood after seeing Sakurai on top of Ikaros and getting the wrong idea. Ikaros hastily chases after her and, as such, Ikaros follows him to school. A card that Sakurai receives from Ikaros glows, and in that instant, Sohara's panties come off and go flying into the sky. It doesn't take much time at all before all the girls in school's panties are flying off into the sky!
2.summary:
Tomoki’s got one of Ikaros’s cards in his possession when he accidentally catches a glimpse of Sohara’s panties! The card’s power activates, and now there’s nothing Sohara can do to keep her panties from flying away!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: エンジェロイド初体験[0シレイ]

3.overview: Tomoki, suffering from a never-ending amount of math homework, decides to have Sugata-senpai help him out. President Satsukitane leads him to Sugata's home, only to find that it's a tent pitched next to a river! Tomoki and the gang have fun camping next to the river after finishing their homework. Ikaros is told to go shopping for ingredients when they all decide to make curry, but...
3.summary:
Ikaros seems to lack some basic computing skills, so Sugata urges Tomoki to assign the Angeloid various tasks in order to learn her strengths and weaknesses. One of her flaws is pretty obvious: she doesn’t know how to have fun.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 愛と三角地帯[トライアングル]ふたたび

4.overview: The flock of panties that flew off into the sky in Episode 2 have returned to Tomoki! Tomoki is estatic, but Sohara uses one of Ikaros's cards to make it so that any panties Tomoki sees will explode. Tomoki decorates his house with all of the panties, without knowing what Sohara has done. Will Tomoki be able to escape from his home with panty explosions looming around every corner? It's the first real action in "SoraOto"!
4.summary:
After Sohara uses one of Ikaros’s cards to make a wish, Tomoki finds himself in an explosive situation: Every time he looks at a pair of panties, the bloomers go boom!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 任侠[セレブ]と初夜[アツイヨル]
title.en: Hot Night with the Big Fish

5.overview: Long story short, Tomoki's house is destroyed. Wandering aimlessly, in search of a place to stay, Tomoki and Ikaros are lent a hand by the class president, Satsukitane. Sohara and Sugata join the mix as they are invited to the home of the town's #1 big shot. They are given a warm reception. But, when they wake up in the morning, there's an angry mob with them!
5.summary:
During a visit to Mikako’s house, Tomoki ends up on the run from gun-toting gangsters. He manages to escape – and quickly finds himself stranded on a deserted island and stalked by a horrifying monster!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 水着軍団[ナミギワ]GO! GO! GO!
title.en: Swimsuit Surf Brigade, Go! Go! Go!

6.overview: Summer vacation. The entire New World Discovery Club heads to the beach. Tomoki is surrounded by attractive girls in their swimsuits, but ends up having to deal with Ikaros. Sohara explodes with jealousy as Tomoki has his full attention on Ikaros. Ikaros shows another frightening side of herself because of a small situation and the second Angeloid...
6.summary:
After the surprising arrival of a new Angeloid named Nymph, the gang heads to the beach! Nymph seems to have a bit of an attitude, but she’s still willing to help when Sohara’s lack of swimming skills puts her in a serious situation.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 電脳少女[トキメキ]の転校生

7.overview: Ikaros and Nymph also settle down in Sakurai's house. They get bored while Itsuki is at school, use a card, and transfer into his school! They instantly become popular as two new beautiful transfer students. But then what does Nymph do when she quickly gets bored at school...?
7.summary:
Ikaros and Nymph make quite a splash when they enroll at Tomoki’s school. Later, mysterious new questions arise when Nymph discovers a shocking secret about Ikaros’s past.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 血斗[マツリ]は誰がために
title.en: For Whom the Shooting Festival Is Held
title.x-jat: Matsuri wa Ta ga Tame ni

8.overview: A fun festival in Sorami town. But, at the student body president's suggestion, the entire town is turned into a survival game! The winner gets $100,000! Gunfire and shrieks fill the air, and who is the mysterious old man who lurks at night? Admist the chaos, Nymph and Ikaros team up to battle for their lives!
8.summary:
A local festival turns into a cork gun shootout, and there’s $100,000 prize for the last person standing. Later, after Nymph reveals her purpose for being on Earth, Ikaros finds herself on the edge of reverting to her former self.
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 嘘から始まる妄想劇場[ストーリー]
title.en: The Delusional Story That Began with a Lie

9.overview: Tomoki and the gang go to an outdoor BBQ. Tomoki tries to open a stall to make some money, but no matter what he does it fails. Then he gets Nymph's help to open a host club! Meanwhile, Ikaros is trying to act like a human for Tomoki's sake when she hears the words "It's human to lie."
9.summary:
Ikaros starts lying to her friends in an effort to act more human. Meanwhile, after Tomoki starts a business in order to raise funds for a saucy DVD, Nymph turns his life upside down by making him irresistible to women!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 天使の旋律[ことば]の向かう先
title.en: Where the Melodious Words Of an Angel Go
title.x-jat: Tenshi no Kotoba no Mukau Saki

10.overview: Tomoki's high school is having a cultural festival with a rich private high school, where Tomoki & the gang perform a song. Ikaros surprises everyone by singing lead vocals.
10.summary:
It’s a musical showdown at the Cultural Fair! Ikaros is the star of the show when Tomoki and the gang put a band together and take on the classical orchestra of the nearby private academy!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: いざ征かん! 我が銭湯領域[パラダイス]
title.en: Off We Go to My Bathhouse Paradise

11.overview: Tomoki invites the girls to a bathhouse.
11.summary:
Tomoki’s on a mission to sneak into the girls’ bathing area. With Sugata’s assistance (and one of Ikaros’s cards) he devises the perfect disguise to accomplish his goal: he transforms into a cute girl!
Source: crunchyroll

title.ja: 逃るること叶わぬ螺旋回廊[クサリ]

12.overview: Tomoki tries to get Ikaros to smile.
12.summary:
No matter how hard their friends try to help, Ikaros and Nymph just can’t seem to crack a smile. After the Angeloids decide to work on the problem together, they take Tomoki out on the town for a three-way date!
Source: crunchyroll

13.overview: The Harpies tell Nymph they are supporting her mission to help capture Ikaros because the Master of Synapse was worried about her. Tomoki and the others prepare for their Christmas party at his home.
13.summary:
After surprising Tomoki with a sudden farewell, Ikaros endures a treacherous encounter with Harpy and Gamma. If Ikaros can find a way to defeat them, she may finally break her chains and find the happiness she desires.
Source: crunchyroll
